verdict.rationale: Bland documents an official MCP server that lets coding agents manage agents, build and validate pathways, and place calls. It also has an official CLI to make calls, build pathways and configure phone numbers, plus a Pathways API and an agent-driven signup flow over plain API calls, so the create-agent, attach-number and place-call chain can be done without the dashboard. Missing for 10: no single documented end-to-end provisioning walkthrough explicitly covering number purchase or attachment through MCP or API, no published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
